title: Bill 77 setting aside housing fund for houseless residents
summary: On June 15 the committee reviewed Bill 77 and is likely to defer it, inviting Director Willis to the next meeting. The bill would require part of the Affordable Housing Fund to go toward housing for houseless residents and adds a definition of "houseless" to county code. The housing director would work with a nonprofit partner, suggested softer wording than "ensure," and said no funds are set aside in fiscal year 27, so a budget amendment would be needed.
